content_text:
我想同你講下Q3市場推廣活動嘅最新進度。我哋而家依家都係按時間表進行，創意素材都快搞掂喇。不過，喺影片製作呢方面，我哋喺供應商度遇到咗啲小遲延。我已經催佢哋今個星期尾之前交貨，但如果佢哋真係唔趕得上，我哋可能要調整下推出日期。等我收到佢哋嘅回覆，我會即時通知你。
[I wanted to give you a quick update on the Q3 marketing campaign. We are currently on track with the timeline, and the creative assets are almost finalized. However, we have hit a slight delay on the vendor side regarding the video production. I am pushing them to deliver by end of this week, but we might need to adjust the launch date if they cannot meet the deadline. I will keep you posted as soon as I hear back from them.]

I wanted to give you a quick update on the Q3 marketing campaign. We are currently on track with the timeline, and the creative assets are almost finalized. However, we have hit a slight delay on the vendor side regarding the video production. I am pushing them to deliver by end of this week, but we might need to adjust the launch date if they cannot meet the deadline. I will keep you posted as soon as I hear back from them.
